id: 03_Power Tools Safety in hindi Power Tools Hazards & Precautions in hindi
title: 电动工具的危害与预防
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/03_Power Tools Safety in hindi Power Tools Hazards & Precautions in hindi.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/03_Power Tools Safety in hindi Power Tools Hazards & Precautions in hindi/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在工作间的工具墙前，墙上挂着电钻、角磨机图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a university workshop in front of a tool wall with an electric drill and an angle grinder hanging on it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电动工具的危害和预防。
overlay: 电动工具的危害与预防

shots.scene: 电钻、闪电、火花、耳朵四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an electric drill, a lightning bolt, flying sparks and an ear. No people.
shots.narration: 好用的工具，也藏着不少风险。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着宽松外套、没戴护目镜，拿起角磨机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a loose open jacket and without safety glasses picks up an angle grinder at a workshop bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰要给支架切个口，抄起角磨机就干。

shots.scene: 角磨机护罩被拆掉、旁边堆着纸箱，图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an angle grinder with its guard removed next to a pile of cardboard boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 护罩拆了，旁边还堆着纸箱。

shots.scene: 老周拔掉插头，摇头指着墙上的防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The older man unplugs the grinder and points at safety glasses and a face shield hanging on the wall.
shots.narration: 老周拔下插头：先防护，再清场。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 我们先看看，电动工具有哪些危害。

shots.scene: 手锯和电锯并排，电锯旁有插头
shots.prompt_en: A hand saw and an electric saw side by side, the electric saw with a power cord and plug. No people.
shots.narration: 不靠人力、靠电力驱动的，就是电动工具。

shots.scene: 角磨机、电钻、切割机、电焊机四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an angle grinder, an electric drill, a small cutting saw and a welding machine. No people.
shots.narration: 像角磨机、电钻、切割机、电焊机。

shots.scene: 电钻电源线破皮，冒出小闪电
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electric drill with a damaged cord sparking, with an electric shock warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第一个危害，是触电。

shots.scene: 火花飞向一桶溶剂，旁边有火焰和爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of sparks flying toward a solvent can, with a flame icon and a burst icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，火灾和爆炸。

shots.scene: 砂轮边缘飞出一串火花
shots.prompt_en: Bright sparks flying from the edge of a grinding wheel icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，打磨切割会飞出火花。

shots.scene: 锯片和一只手形图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a saw blade near a hand pictogram with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，刀片锯片容易割伤人。

shots.scene: 火花落在手臂图标上留下红点
shots.prompt_en: An icon of sparks landing on an arm pictogram leaving small red burn marks. No people.
shots.narration: 第五，火花溅到身上会烧伤。

shots.scene: 耳朵图标旁边很大的声波
shots.prompt_en: An ear icon with large loud sound waves coming at it. No people.
shots.narration: 第六，噪声大，伤听力。

shots.scene: 握着工具的双手图标，旁边有抖动线
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two hands gripping a vibrating power tool with shaking lines around them. No people.
shots.narration: 第七，长时间振动，伤手伤臂。

shots.scene: 七个危害图标排成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Seven small hazard icons arranged in a circle: shock, flame, sparks, blade, burn, ear, vibration. No people.
shots.narration: 七种危害，记住了吗？

shots.scene: 工具插在带漏电保护器的插座箱上
shots.prompt_en: A power tool plugged into a socket box equipped with a residual current breaker with a test button. No people.
shots.narration: 预防第一条：电源要有漏电保护。

shots.scene: 潮湿场所旁有安全电压变压器图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a damp area with a small isolating transformer and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿等特殊场所，按规定用安全电压。

shots.scene: 手松开开关，工具停转
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand releasing the trigger of a drill, and the drill bit stops spinning. No people.
shots.narration: 开关要能松手即停。

shots.scene: 开关被胶带缠死的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tool trigger taped down in the on position, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能把开关卡死在常开位置。

shots.scene: 角磨机带着完好的护罩，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An angle grinder with its wheel guard properly in place, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 防护罩要装好，不能拆掉。

shots.scene: 小研把纸箱和溶剂瓶搬离工作台
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves cardboard boxes and a closed solvent can away from the workshop bench.
shots.narration: 作业区先清走可燃、易燃物。

shots.scene: 砂轮片标签图标和机器标签图标，比大小
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinding disc with a blank rating label and a grinder with a blank rating label, with a greater-than symbol between them. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮片的额定转速，要高于机器转速。

shots.scene: 碎裂的砂轮片图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cracked grinding disc, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 选错片子，转起来就会碎裂飞出。

shots.scene: 工作区用防火挡板围起，火花被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A workshop area surrounded by fire resistant screens, sparks stopped by the screens. No people.
shots.narration: 火花要用挡板围住，不让飞出去。

shots.scene: 带挡帘的焊接隔间
shots.prompt_en: A welding booth with flame resistant curtains around it, empty. No people.
shots.narration: 电焊要在专门的隔离区进行。

shots.scene: 焊接图标旁有空白审批单
shots.prompt_en: A welding icon next to a blank approval form with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 校内动火，先按规定审批。

shots.scene: 灭火器标志下有灭火器和灭火毯
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign above a fire extinguisher and a folded fire blanket. No people.
shots.narration: 现场备好灭火器和灭火毯。

shots.scene: 老李站在作业区旁看护，手边有灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands watch beside a work area with a fire extinguisher at hand.
shots.narration: 安排受过培训的人专门看火。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，再放下面罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on safety goggles and then lowers a clear face shield over them.
shots.narration: 眼睛要双重防护：护目镜加面罩。

shots.scene: 皮手套和防火围裙图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pair of leather work gloves and a flame resistant apron. No people.
shots.narration: 打磨焊接，戴皮手套、穿围裙。

shots.scene: 耳塞和耳罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pair of foam ear plugs and a pair of ear muffs. No people.
shots.narration: 噪声大时，戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.scene: 时钟图标和两个人形图标交替
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with two person pictograms swapping places with circular arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 长时间作业，要轮换休息。

shots.scene: 老周拍拍阿杰肩膀，换小研接手
shots.prompt_en: The older man taps the young male student on the shoulder, and the female graduate student takes over the bench.
shots.narration: 减少噪声和振动的累积伤害。

shots.scene: 王老师在工作间给学生讲解工具
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains power tool use to a small group of students in a university workshop.
shots.narration: 工作间的工具，先培训再使用。

shots.scene: 空白培训合格卡和空白登记本
shots.prompt_en: A blank training card next to a blank sign-in logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 考核合格，登记后才能上手。

shots.scene: 电焊图标旁有空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: A welding icon next to a blank work permit card. No people.
shots.narration: 电焊等特种作业，必须持证。

shots.scene: 小研检查电钻的外壳、电源线和插头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects an electric drill's housing, cord and plug before use.
shots.narration: 用前检查：外壳、电线、插头。

shots.scene: 开关、护罩、刀头三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a trigger switch, a wheel guard and a drill bit. No people.
shots.narration: 开关、护罩、刀具也要看一看。

shots.scene: 坏工具挂上空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A damaged power tool with a blank out of service tag hanging on it, placed in a separate bin. No people.
shots.narration: 有问题的工具，挂牌停用、报修。

shots.scene: 钻床旋转的钻头旁有卷入警示
shots.prompt_en: A drill press with a spinning bit and a yellow warning triangle showing an entanglement pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 旋转部件会把东西卷进去。

shots.scene: 长发、松散袖口、手套、项链靠近钻头，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of long loose hair, a loose sleeve, a glove and a necklace near a spinning bit, all crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 长发盘起，袖口扎紧，不戴首饰。

shots.scene: 钻床旁戴手套的手图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gloved hand near a drill press spindle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 操作钻床等旋转设备，不戴手套。

shots.scene: 工件被台钳夹牢
shots.prompt_en: A metal workpiece clamped firmly in a bench vise, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 工件用夹具夹牢，不用手扶。

shots.scene: 小研双手握持电钻，站姿平稳
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds an electric drill firmly with both hands, wearing safety glasses, standing steadily.
shots.narration: 双手握稳工具，站稳再开机。

shots.scene: 工具停转后才放在台面上
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a grinder whose wheel has fully stopped being placed down on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 完全停转，再放下工具。

shots.scene: 换钻头前先拔下插头的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug pulled out of the socket before a drill bit is changed. No people.
shots.narration: 换刀头、换砂轮，先拔电源。

shots.scene: 电线横在过道上的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power cord stretched across a walkway, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电线不横穿过道，防止绊倒。

shots.scene: 阿杰把工具断电后挂回工具墙
shots.prompt_en: The young male student unplugs a tool and hangs it back on the workshop tool wall.
shots.narration: 用完断电，清理现场，放回原位。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a first aid kit with a first aid sign on it.
shots.narration: 万一受伤，先停机断电。

shots.scene: 按压止血和冲洗眼睛两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a hand pressing a clean gauze on a cut, and an eye being rinsed with water at an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 割伤压迫止血，异物入眼要冲洗。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标旁的手被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand rubbing an eye, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要揉眼睛，尽快就医。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 伤情严重，立即拨打120。

shots.scene: 报告链条图标：实验室—学院—保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a workshop room, a department building and a security office. No people.
shots.narration: 报告负责人和学院，起火报保卫处。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现七个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside seven floating hazard icons.
shots.narration: 触电、起火、火花、割伤，还有噪声振动。

shots.scene: 漏电保护器、松手开关、防护罩三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a residual current breaker, a trigger switch and a wheel guard. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电保护、松手即停、护罩装好。

shots.scene: 清场、挡板、灭火器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an empty clean bench, a fire resistant screen and a fire extinguisher. No people.
shots.narration: 清走易燃物，挡住火花，备好灭火器。

shots.scene: 护目镜、面罩、手套、耳罩四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: safety goggles, a face shield, leather gloves and ear muffs. No people.
shots.narration: 眼、脸、手、耳，防护到位。

shots.scene: 检查、夹具、拔插头三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a magnifying glass over a tool, a bench vise and an unplugged plug. No people.
shots.narration: 用前检查，夹牢工件，换刀断电。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜，在整洁的工作间挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing safety glasses waves goodbye at the camera in a tidy university workshop.
shots.narration: 工具用得稳，安全才有底，下次见！
